mapper.sql: project_id AS "projectId" , project_name AS "projectName" , repository AS "repository" , local_path AS "localPath" , branch AS "branch" , root_packages AS "rootPackages" , java_version AS "javaVersion" , source_encoding AS "sourceEncoding" , description AS "description" , to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_project (project_id, project_name, local_path, root_packages, java_version, source_encoding, description) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{localPath}, #{rootPackages}, #{javaVersion}, #{sourceEncoding}, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE SET project_name = EXCLUDED.project_name , local_path = EXCLUDED.local_path , root_packages = EXCLUDED.root_packages , java_version = EXCLUDED.java_version , source_encoding = EXCLUDED.source_encoding , description = EXCLUDED.description , updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_project ORDER BY project_id
